newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber falls sharply on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber falls sharply on long liquidation.

text.p: CME lumber futures tumbled for sharp losses early, paced by January as slow cash trade and long liquidation weighed on prices, traders said.

Follow-though support from Monday's late strength was lacking and January led the setback as the long liquidation developed. Other months followed with a few sell stops adding to the setback before running into support.

January was off as much as $13.10 per tbf and March fell $8.20 before finding support. At 0937 CST, futures stood $9.70 to $2.20 lower with January off $9.70 at $424.00 and March off $5.20 at $424.50 per tbf.

Cash trade has been slower than expected which weighed on sentiment and in turn, futures. Poor weather over much of the country and forecasts for bitter cold temperatures into the weekend will likely keep demand for lumber slow, traders said.
